Name: Overcast - Cloud Shadows
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Overcast adds immersive cloud shadows across the valley, moving gently in the wind. Highly configurable, performance optimised, and compatible with just about everything.[/color]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with all recolours and other visual mods, layers on top of all visuals[/*]
[*]Has built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url], with special behaviour for most weathers added by the mod[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adjust darkness, wind speed, and cloud size[/*]
[*]Adjust when clouds are enabled (during rain, snow, storms, special weathers from Weather Wonders, etc)[/*]
[*]Enable an optional second layer, with much lighter, much slower moving clouds.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Performance[/b][/size]
Unlike other full-scale shaders like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40775]Dynamic Shader[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49397]Radiance[/url] which have similar cloud shadow features, Overcast is designed to be a very lightweight, focussed mod.

Technical details:
[list]
[*]Small capped cloud population[/*]
[*]Culls clouds outside the viewport[/*]
[*]Clouds are static sprites that transition each tick, no shaders, render targets, per-frame allocations, etc[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Overcast
Manifest.Description: Subtle, drifting cloud shadows for outdoor locations.
Manifest.Author: heyitsmads
